lines.en: : You’re absolutely sure you want to do this, right? Because no one is going to blame you if you want to take a little longer before going back to school.
: This isn’t school, Niki. I’m just going to a party. And if I stay cooped up in here any longer, everybody might forget who I am.
: I know you’re not going to school now. But that’s what comes next, isn’t it? If you’re going back on Monday, this is basically a trial run. And I just want to make sure you’re 100%% ready to-
: I’ll be okay, Niki. At the very least, Ayane, Sana, and Maya don’t hate me. So I can just hang out with them if everyone else is still afraid of me being an incestuous serial killer.
: You really need to knock it off with the incest crap, Ami. It’s super creepy and not okay to joke about things like that.
: If you say so. But I don’t think any of the other girls are going to buy that I was just joking about that stuff when it was sort of just me saying what needed to be said.
: Yeah...I don’t think anyone expects Ami’s feelings for Sensei to be anything short of “extremely serious” at this point in time. We’ve kind of just accepted them.
: I don’t think...everyone has accepted them, though...
: I know I haven’t.
: Well, what would it take to change your mind?
: Nothing! And even without the incest part, it’s really rude to say things like that about someone’s boyfriend to their face! I’d seriously ground you if you weren’t so cute right now.
: You might live here now, Niki, but only my dad is allowed to discipline me. I just hope he isn’t too rough with my tiny body! Or is. Both ways are fine.
: So you’re really moving in, Niki? You’re not worried about word getting out and stuff?

: Not really. If it happens, it happens. Besides, I’m sure my agency would be able to spin it into some sappy story about me winding up with my childhood friend. Hell, maybe I’ll even get my own TV drama.
: You know how to act?
: Obviously! You think the real Niki Nakayama is the one all you girls see on stage all the time? Hell no! I’m a stuck-up brat who’s only confident when I’m getting paid to be. Just ask your teacher.
: Or...former teacher I guess. His future remains to be determined.
: What happens if...your agency isn’t able to...spin the story you want, though?...
: I guess I become a full-time mom.
: Step-mom.
: Whatever you want to call it. I’ll just go from being Kumon-mi’s idol to Ami’s. And I’ll spend my days making her happy instead of everyone else.
: My career’s been long enough. And I’ve been virtually scandal-free the whole time. So if I’m going to go out, at least I’ll go out with a bang.
: Besides, I’ve got other options too. Like, not being active anymore would let me actually open up a training studio. I’m trying to stay optimistic, you know?
: Being an idol is great and all. But this is the real dream come true for me. And I’d take that over anything else in the whole wide world.
: She’s moving in?! Are you fucking kidding me?! Her?! You know how I feel about her! How could you do this to me?!
: Oh, right. I guess I forgot to tell you.
: You forgot to-
: Sensei...please tell me this is just some sick joke. Because if Niki is moving in with you, that means...
: That...
: It...means that...
: What does it mean? Spit it out. Because if you keep yelling, it’s only a matter of time until she walks in.
: How am I supposed to compete with her?...
: If you have Niki...what am I supposed to do? What are we supposed to do? Because I’ve always been fine with being a secret. But the whole point of that was so this wouldn’t happen.
: We’re a couple- as sappy and gross as that is to admit. A couple. Two people. You give me what I lack, and I give you what you lack. You won’t lack anything with her. She’s perfect.
: You’re not doing a very good job at persuading me to kick her out if your main argument is that she’s perfect and she’ll make me feel whole.
: But what about me?! Forever means forever! You can’t just change your mind without giving me a chance!

: Like...think about it! You left her once already! You did that for a reason! You can’t just change your mind because her stalker sister found you and dragged you back! That wasn’t supposed to happen!
: That happened a while ago, Maya. And I’m not just doing this for me. I’m doing it for Ami.
: Ami doesn’t want this either, you fucking moron! This is the worst thing that’s ever happened to her!
: That-
: Since her parents died, obviously. But you fucking know how protective she is over you and all this will do is weigh even heavier on her already fucked up Ami-brain! How dumb are you?!
: She needs a mother figure, Maya. And I need to be more of a father.
: Literally none of that has ever mattered before!
: Yeah, and look how that worked out.
: I can’t just sit back and let her go insane. I need to try and...fix her, so to speak.
: No you don’t...not if it means risking your safety.

: You need to be fixed too. We both do. That’s why we’re together in the first place. You’re seriously going to look at me and say that’s not what you want anymore? After everything we’ve been through?
: For the millionth time...I haven’t been through anything with-
: I’ll listen.
: What?
: To this...old Maya shit. I get that it’s not just a joke anymore. If I do that, will you stay? Will you get rid of her? Can it be just us again?
: I’ll do anything you want, Sensei. Like, maybe you’re right! Maybe I have changed! But that just means I can change again! Let me change again! You have to love me more than her! You have to!
: What’s all this about love?
: What’s going on in here? What’s all the yelling about?
: I was just helping Maya here with some personal issues since I haven’t been able to give her any counseling at school lately.
: Ahh, love problems? I get the screaming now. I know better than most how hard that stuff can-
: Don’t talk to me. I don’t like you.
: Oh. Well, okay. I guess I won’t compliment you on your costume either, then.
: Would you look at this, Aki-kun! The gang’s all back together! Your three true loves in one place!
: How’s about we all strip down and suck you off in alphabetical order? Going by family names, of course. So just like old times, I get to go first!
: Not now...can’t you see I’m in the middle of something here?
: Well, duh. I wouldn’t have shown myself if I didn’t. I just want to know what you’re going to do next since it could directly impact the amount of times you hallucinate me going forward.
: Any guidance you could give me about which choice will lead to me never hallucinating you again?
: Akira, you wound me! Your words hurt far more than any car accident ever could!
: So, which one’s it gonna be?
: Your cute and loving childhood friend? Or the selfish, neurotic meat-pocket you found in a dumpster somewhere and proceeded to fuck for the next trillion years since you missed me so much?
: Well, I clearly don’t have to ask you which one you prefer.
: I have my problems with Niki too, of course.
: You keep your hands off of my precious daughter, you hear me?! Only Aki-kun’s allowed to put it in her! We’ve gotta keep the bloodline strong!
: But yeah! Apart from moving in and taking my place as my perfect little girl’s matriarch, I think this one’s really sweet. That “Shining Star” song is a real bop too.
: If I had to pick anyone, though, I like that Nodoka girl the most. Do you know what she’s doing right now? It’s super impressive. Also, you probably don’t know this about her, but-
: Sekai...leave.
: Aaaah! Aki-kun hates me now! If only I had never died, then none of this would have ever happened and we’d all be going trick-or-treating together!
: Are you done?
: Additionally, I’d like to express my great dissatisfaction toward the societal norms that barred me from marrying him instead of his big meanie brother! Waaaaaah!
: Leave. Now.
: Nooooooooo! I’m dying again!!!!!!!!!
Maya leaves the room.
: Jesus. What the hell was that girl’s problem?
: She doesn’t like idols. You don’t have to worry about it, Niki.
: Sure, fine. But do you know what I do have to worry about? The fact that Ami keeps openly admitting to wanting to screw you even in front of her friends. That isn’t okay.
: I’m aware. I don’t want her doing that either. But I have no idea how to stop it and she’s only getting more open about it as time goes on.
: Then...maybe we should keep her here a little while longer? I’m already on the fence about her going to that party tonight anyway and-
: She’ll be with me. I’ll keep an eye on her. Don’t worry.
: I just don’t think she’s ready yet, babe. I’m worried about her.
: Good. That’s why you’re here, remember?
: I trust you, Niki.
: And I know this was the right decision...
: Maya? What’s wrong? Where are-
: Enjoy your stupid party! I’m not going!
: Um...but...aren’t we all-
: Not anymore! But it’s not like anybody even gives a shit anyway, so fuck it! See you in school!
: What...happened?
: Do you think she...got into an argument with Sensei? She kind of just...disappeared once Niki walked in, so...I assumed she was with him.
: Ugh...probably. If I had known Niki was going to be here, I wouldn’t have suggested meeting at your house in the first place.
: Does...Maya have a problem with Niki?
: I could ask you the same question. Never in a million years did I think you’d give the green light to another girl moving in with you and Sensei. Especially one who isn’t named Ayane.
: Sensei...thinks it’s for the best. And I like Niki, so...

: I know...I know. That’s just...going to take some getting used to, that’s all. Besides, we don’t know for sure that’s why Maya stormed out. But of course now I’m going to have to chase after her to find out.
: Maybe...I can do that instead?

: What? No! You haven’t done anything with the class in forever. And I don’t want to risk you not getting to participate at all if you can’t even find her. Not after you and Niki worked so hard on your costume.
: It’s fine...really. You’ll be missed more than me. And Niki was already kind of worried about me going in the first place, so...this is probably what’s best for everyone.
: B-Besides, it’s super weird to be late to a party at your own house. And at this rate, it’s kind of...inevitable.
: Hah...are you sure? Because I really don’t mind, Ami. I’ve gotten pretty good at talking to Maya lately. Or at least...as good as one can be when talking to Maya.
: I’m positive...
: I’ll find her and bring her back. I promise. I’m good at talking to her too.
: Okay...
: I’ll let Makoto and the others know we’re on our way. I think they should be about done decorating now.
: Can you do me a favor and let Makoto know she’s a stupid four-eyed know-it-all loser too?
